features.title: CLI Forge: AST-based CLI command forging from Python source
acceptance: POST /api/forge with Python source returns a manifest of callable entry points with typed argument schemas
Each generated command is executable shell syntax: program <name> [--flag value]...
Argparse/argparse.parse_args call sites are detected as real entry points
Malformed source returns a 422 with a safe error message, never a 500

features.title: CLI Forge dashboard: paste source, view forged commands, export
acceptance: Form to paste Python source and submit
Results rendered as copyable shell commands

features.title: Save, list and retrieve forged manifests in SQLite
acceptance: GET /api/forges lists saved forges with pagination

features.title: OIDC Keycloak SAML-brokering authentication and role authorization
acceptance: state+nonce+PKCE authorization code login through Keycloak
viewer/operator/admin roles enforced on data endpoints

features.title: Opt-in LLM advisory explanations with provider adapters
acceptance: Advisory label, bounded timeouts, redacted errors, never fabricated success

features.title: Support JS/TS, Go and Rust source targets
acceptance: ES/TS AST or parser service extracts entry points
Go/Rust function recovery via go/parser and syn
